questions.prompt: What money is used in Ivory Coast?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Ivory Coast is the West African CFA franc.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Ivory Coast about 322,463 square kilometres; Ghana about 238,535 square kilometres; Senegal about 196,722 square kilometres; Liberia about 111,369 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which continent is Ivory Coast in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Ivory Coast on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Ivory Coast on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Ivory Coast?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ivory Coast article.

questions.proof: The capital of Côte d'Ivoire is Yamoussoukro but its biggest city is Abidjan.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Yamoussoukro?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Ivory Coast is Yamoussoukro.
